subject_session: Achilles_10252013, Buddy_06272013, Cicero_09012014, Cicero_09172014, Gatsby_08022013 (5 linear-maze sessions)
stated_limitation: The main caveat is that the phase reference is a single LFP channel picked by theta/delta ratio with no independent depth calibration, so the absolute preferred phases reported here are not directly comparable to studies referenced to the pyramidal-layer trough. Relative phase, which is what both phenomena depend on, is unaffected.

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 (Grosmark & Buzsáki CA1 linear maze) is the canonical dataset for theta entrainment and phase precession, analyzed across all five linear-maze sessions.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile with correct epoch/lap alignment, explicit speed and quality filtering, and documented handling of the out-of-order spike and the position sampling-period quirk.
justification.analysis: Correct circular statistics throughout: Rayleigh test and MRL for entrainment, Kempter circular-linear regression for precession, with a 500-permutation phase-shuffle null for significance.
justification.correctness: Every headline number (346 units, 233 locked, 155 fields, 116 precessing, median slope -0.54, U=13419, W=1568, p=6.3e-16) reproduces exactly from the committed CSVs and is internally consistent and statistically sound.
justification.figures: Figures are clearly labeled with units and sample sizes, show the negative diagonal precession band and phase-locked distributions plainly, and example units are chosen by correlation strength (rho), the correct effect criterion.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate to strong evidence, examples are honestly labeled rather than passed off as typical, and specific limitations (single-channel reference, no depth calibration, field-definition circularity) are named explicitly.
